claims.text: Malacca’s municipal account distinguishes Portuguese conquest from a later Dutch governor’s residence and administrative centre. Aceh’s account describes Iskandar Muda and a royal palace through an attributed retrospective. Conquest in one port does not establish the other port’s ruler, office or consent. These are separate maritime institutions, not one city’s sequence applied to both.
